description: A Western Republican member of Congress seeks a Legislative Assistant for his Washington, D.C. office. The Assistant's primary areas of focus are Armed Services and Veteran's Affairs. Additional assignments may include Foreign Affairs and Space/Aerospace. The Assistant supports the Representative's legislative priorities through legislative research, drafting legislation, acting as liaison to relevant committees, working with the Congressional Research Service, and identifying strategies to advance legislative priorities. The Assistant prepares the member for committee hearings, staffs those hearings, and monitors/reports to the Representative when he is unable to attend. The Assistant also assists in preparing for interviews, meetings with constituents and interest groups, drafts responses to constituent mail, drafts speeches and correspondence with executive agencies, and develops co-sponsorship and vote recommendations.
